title: Special Executive Programme In Media And Communication Industry
description: Gain expertise in media and communication dynamics, regulations, and strategic influence across industries.
longDescription: This programme provides an in-depth exploration of communication models, media regulations, and the interaction between media and society. It covers global media theories, strategic communication, and the evolution of modern media.
courseDetails: Learn the essential elements of communication, effective media interaction, and the impact of social values on communication. Study corporate media regulations, mass media's role in society, and strategic communication in advertising and public relations. Explore the evolution of online media and understand stakeholder roles in the media communication industry. After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to: Communication as Interaction: • Explore the definition and purpose of communication. • Understand the elements of communication. • Explore different models of Communication as Interaction. • Understand what Effective Communication is. • Explore Global Media Theories (e.g. Authoritarian, Communist, Libertarian, Social Responsibility). • Understand Levels of Communication/Structure. • Understand Styles and Techniques: Oral, Written, and Business. Media Regulations and Corporate Media and Communication: ⦁ Explore how the media industry is regulated in different ways. ⦁ Understand Corporate Media and Communication Media. ⦁ Understand the laws of Government to control the Press. ⦁ Understand Global Media and Communication around the World. ⦁ Explore the Future of Mass Media. ⦁ Explore Modern Media Delivery Pros and Cons. Interaction of Media Society and Strategic Communication: ⦁ Understand Media Literacy. ⦁ Understand the Role of Social Values in Communication and The Effect on our Lives – Media Transformation Including Cultivation Theory, Functionalism, Agenda Setting, Uses and Gratifications Theory, and Social Learning. ⦁ Understand Mass media, Popular Culture and Media Convergence. ⦁ Understand Strategic Communication by exploring the development of the Advertising Industry. ⦁ Analyze the Business of Public Relations. Evolution of Media and Communication: ⦁ Understand the Evolution of Media and Communication. ⦁ Explore Online Media, its tools, advantages, and disadvantages. ⦁ Understand the Stakeholder roles in Media Communication Industry.
